Added: Colon-style path segments (e.g. :id) in request URLs are converted to brace-style placeholders (e.g. {id})
Path parameters are extracted from Postman's url.variable list (or inferred from :name segments when absent) and imported as a path-table block with their values
Postman environment and globals exports can now be imported directly — enabled variables are written into the project's .env files, using the environment name as the comment header
